E01-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1
E01-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1
E01-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1
E01-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1
E02-CAS: SELECT iata_cd, icao_cd, bez FROM flghf WHERE nachtflugverb_kz = 1
E02-SCH: SELECT iata_cd FROM flghf WHERE nachtflugverb_kz = 1 ORDER BY iata_cd
E02-BIZ: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, flghf.icao_cd FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE flghf.nachtflugverb_kz = 1
E02-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, flghf.land FROM flghf WHERE flghf.nachtflugverb_kz = 0
E03-CAS: SELECT bez FROM flges WHERE allianz = 'CargoLink'
E03-SCH: SELECT bez FROM flges WHERE allianz = 'CargoLink' ORDER BY bez
E03-BIZ: SELECT bez, rufz, gruend_jahr, hub_fh_nr, sitz_ort FROM flges WHERE allianz = 'CargoLink'
E03-VAG: SELECT knd_ref FROM sndg WHERE kunnr IN (SELECT kunnr FROM flges WHERE allianz = 'CargoLink')
E04-CAS: SELECT mdl FROM lfz_typ WHERE herst = 'Airbus'
E04-SCH: SELECT mdl FROM lfz_typ WHERE herst = 'Airbus'
E04-BIZ: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, lfz_typ.typ_nr, lfz_typ.anz_trw, lfz_typ.spannw_m, lfz_typ.max_reichw_km, lfz_typ.leergew_kg, lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.baujahr, lfz.flges_nr, lfz.ausl_dat, lfz.ges_flugstd FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz_typ.herst = 'Airbus'
E04-VAG: SELECT mdl, trw_mdl, anz_trw, spannw_m FROM lfz_typ WHERE herst = 'Airbus'
E05-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfz WHERE eigt_art = 'leased'
E05-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfz WHERE eigt_art = 'leased'
E05-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfz WHERE eigt_art = 'leased'
E05-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfz WHERE eigt_art = 'leased'
E06-CAS: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.stat FROM lfz WHERE lfz.stat != 'active'
E06-SCH: SELECT kennz, stat FROM lfz WHERE stat != 'active'
E06-BIZ: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.msn, lfz.stat, lfz.baujahr, lfz.flges_nr, wartg.mro_dienstl, wartg.wartg_id, wartg.auftr_nr, wartg.beginn, wartg.anz_zurueckgest FROM lfz LEFT JOIN wartg ON lfz.lfz_nr = wartg.lfz_nr WHERE lfz.stat IN ('maintenance', 'retired')
E06-VAG: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.kennz, lfz.baujahr, lfz.flges_nr, lfz.stat, lfz.ausl_dat, lfz_typ.typ_nr, lfz_typ.anz_trw, lfz_typ.spannw_m, lfz_typ.max_reichw_km, lfz_typ.leergew_kg, lfz_typ.reise_geschw_kmh FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'retired'
E07-CAS: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(kunnr) AS customer_count FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E07-SCH: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(*) FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E07-BIZ: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(kunnr) AS headcount FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E07-VAG: SELECT knd_stamm.treue_stufe, COUNT(knd_stamm.kunnr) AS customer_count FROM knd_stamm JOIN zahlg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = zahlg.kunnr WHERE knd_stamm.knd_typ = 'customer' GROUP BY knd_stamm.treue_stufe
E08-CAS: SELECT kunnr, name1, ort FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E08-SCH: SELECT name1, ort FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E08-BIZ: SELECT kunnr, ort FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E08-VAG: SELECT kunnr, kto_cd, name1, land, ort, strasse, plz, ansprechp, ansp_mail, ansp_tel, web_adr, vertr_reg, kredlim_usd, zahlbed_tg, bek_versender_kz, treue_stufe, erdat FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E09-CAS: SELECT lgr_typ, COUNT(*) FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr_typ
E09-SCH: SELECT lgr_typ, COUNT(*) FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr_typ
E09-BIZ: SELECT lgr_typ, COUNT(*) AS warehouse_count FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr_typ
E09-VAG: SELECT lgr.lgr_typ, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS warehouse_count FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr.lgr_typ
E10-CAS: SELECT SUM(flaeche_m2) AS total_floor_space FROM lgr WHERE lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
E10-SCH: SELECT SUM(flaeche_m2) FROM lgr WHERE lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
E10-BIZ: SELECT SUM(lgr.flaeche_m2) AS total_cold_chain_footprint FROM lgr WHERE lgr.lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
E10-VAG: SELECT SUM(lgr.flaeche_m2) AS total_cold_chain_space FROM lgr WHERE lgr.lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
M01-CAS: SELECT flges.flges_nr, flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS plane_count FROM flges LEFT JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, flges.bez ORDER BY plane_count DESC
M01-SCH: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS aircraft_count FROM flges LEFT JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez ORDER BY aircraft_count DESC, flges.bez
M01-BIZ: SELECT flges.flges_nr, flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS fleet_size FROM flges LEFT JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, flges.bez ORDER BY fleet_size DESC
M01-VAG: SELECT flges.flges_nr, flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS aircraft_count, AVG(lfz.ges_flugstd) AS avg_flight_hours, AVG(lfz.baujahr) AS avg_age, AVG(lfz_typ.max_reichw_km) AS avg_range_km, AVG(lfz_typ.spannw_m) AS avg_span_m, AVG(lfz_typ.leergew_kg) AS avg_empty_weight_kg, AVG(lfz_typ.reise_geschw_kmh) AS avg_cruise_speed_kmh, SUM(CASE WHEN wartg.aog_kz = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aog_count FROM flges LEFT JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr LEFT JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr LEFT JOIN wartg ON lfz.lfz_nr = wartg.lfz_nr GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, flges.bez
M02-CAS: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS active_count FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-SCH: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS active_count FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl ORDER BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-BIZ: SELECT lfz_typ.icao_typ, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS active_count FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.icao_typ
M02-VAG: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS active_count FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M03-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flug WHERE abfl_fh IN (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST') AND stat = 'completed'
M03-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' AND abfl_fh = (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST')
M03-BIZ: SELECT SUM(sndg.ges_vol_m3) AS completed_departure_volume FROM flug JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id JOIN sndg ON flug.ziel_fh = sndg.urspr_fh WHERE flug.abfl_fh IN (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST') AND flug.stat = 'completed' AND betankg.stat = 'completed' AND sndg.stat = 'in_transit'
M03-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) AS busy_level FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf.fh_nr WHERE flghf.iata_cd = 'IST'
M04-CAS: SELECT flghf1.bez AS from_airport, flghf2.bez AS to_airport, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flug JOIN flghf flghf1 ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf1.fh_nr JOIN flghf flghf2 ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf2.fh_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf1.fh_nr, flghf2.fh_nr ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-SCH: SELECT flghf1.iata_cd AS origin_iata, flghf2.iata_cd AS destination_iata, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM flug JOIN flghf flghf1 ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf1.fh_nr JOIN flghf flghf2 ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf2.fh_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf1.iata_cd, flghf2.iata_cd ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 5
M04-BIZ: SELECT flug_ladg.ladg_id, flug_ladg.uld_nr, COUNT(flug_ladg.flug_id) AS flight_count FROM flug_ladg JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flug_ladg.ladg_id, flug_ladg.uld_nr ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez AS airport_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sndg.sndg_nr) AS shipment_count FROM flghf JOIN sndg ON flghf.fh_nr = sndg.ziel_fh GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr ORDER BY shipment_count DESC LIMIT 10
M05-CAS: SELECT AVG(T1.versp_min) FROM vorf AS T1 INNER JOIN flug AS T2 ON T1.ladg_id = T2.flug_id WHERE T2.stat = 'completed'
M05-SCH: SELECT AVG((strftime('%s', T1.ank_ist) - strftime('%s', T1.ank_plan)) / 60) AS avg_delay, T3.bez FROM flug AS T1 JOIN lfz AS T2 ON T1.lfz_nr = T2.lfz_nr JOIN flghf AS T3 ON T1.ziel_fh = T3.fh_nr WHERE T1.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY T3.bez ORDER BY avg_delay DESC LIMIT 1
M05-BIZ: SELECT AVG(v.versp_min) AS avg_delay, f.flges_nr, f.gruend_jahr, f.rufz FROM vorf v JOIN flug f ON v.ladg_id = f.ladg_id WHERE v.vorf_art = 'delay' GROUP BY f.flges_nr, f.gruend_jahr, f.rufz
M05-VAG: SELECT flges.flges_nr, flges.bez, flges.gruend_jahr, flges.hub_fh_nr, flges.land, flges.allianz, flges.icao_cd FROM flges ORDER BY flges.gruend_jahr DESC LIMIT 1
M06-CAS: SELECT flges.iata_cd, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS cancelled_flights FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flges.iata_cd
M06-SCH: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS cancelled_flights FROM flug JOIN lfz ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flghf ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf.fh_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flghf.bez ORDER BY cancelled_flights DESC
M06-BIZ: SELECT flges.flges_nr, flges.rufz, SUM(sndg.ges_vol_m3) AS cancellation_volume FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr JOIN sndg ON flug.flug_id = sndg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, flges.rufz
M06-VAG: SELECT flges.flges_nr, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS cancellations FROM flges LEFT JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr AND flug.storno_grund IS NOT NULL GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, flges.bez
M07-CAS: SELECT flges.iata_cd, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS total_co2 FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flugnr JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flges.iata_cd
M07-SCH: SELECT flges.bez, ROUND(SUM(betankg.co2_kg / 1000), 1) AS avg_co2_kg FROM betankg JOIN flug ON betankg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN lfz ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flges ON lfz.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez
M07-BIZ: SELECT flges.rufz AS Carrier, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS CarbonFootprint FROM flges JOIN betankg ON flges.flges_nr = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flges.rufz
M07-VAG: SELECT flges.flges_nr, flges.bez, SUM(lfz.ges_flugstd) AS total_flight_hours FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, flges.bez
M08-CAS: SELECT AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) AS avg_fuel_price_per_liter, flghf.reg FROM betankg JOIN flghf ON betankg.fh_nr = flghf.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-SCH: SELECT flghf.reg, ROUND(AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l), 4) AS avg_preis_usd_l FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-BIZ: SELECT flghf.reg, AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) AS avg_fuel_price_per_liter FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-VAG: SELECT fh_nr, AVG(preis_usd_l) AS avg_price_per_liter FROM betankg GROUP BY fh_nr ORDER BY avg_price_per_liter DESC LIMIT 1
M09-CAS: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS warehouse_count FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) >= 4
M09-SCH: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS lgr_count FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd HAVING lgr_count >= 4
M09-BIZ: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS warehouse_count FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr HAVING warehouse_count >= 4
M09-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez, flghf.fh_nr, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS warehouse_count FROM flghf LEFT JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr ORDER BY warehouse_count DESC LIMIT 10
M10-CAS: SELECT flghf.bez, flghf.fh_nr FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
M10-SCH: SELECT flges.iata_cd, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS zoll_warehouse_count FROM lgr JOIN flghf ON lgr.fh_nr = flghf.fh_nr JOIN flges ON flges.flges_nr = flghf.hub_kz WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flges.iata_cd HAVING zoll_warehouse_count > 1
M10-BIZ: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS num_customs_bonded_facilities FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr, flghf.bez HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
M10-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez, flghf.fh_nr, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS num_bonded_warehouses FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
H01-CAS: SELECT flges.iata_cd, flges.bez, lfz.kennz, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flges.iata_cd, flges.bez, lfz.kennz ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H01-SCH: SELECT lfz.kennz, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS flug_count FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz ORDER BY flug_count DESC, lfz.kennz ASC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT flges.flges_nr, flges.bez, lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.kennz, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN bes_eins ON flug.flug_id = bes_eins.flug_id JOIN wartg ON lfz.lfz_nr = wartg.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND bes_eins.eins_stat = 'completed' AND wartg.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, lfz.lfz_nr ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H01-VAG: SELECT flges.flges_nr, flges.bez, lfz.kennz, lfz.typ_nr, lfz.baujahr, lfz.stat, SUM(betankg.menge_kg) AS total_fuel_loaded FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr JOIN betankg ON lfz.lfz_nr = betankg.lfz_nr GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, lfz.lfz_nr ORDER BY total_fuel_loaded DESC LIMIT 1
H02-CAS: SELECT flghf.bez AS airport_name, flges.iata_cd AS airline_code, COUNT(*) AS landing_count FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ziel_fh = flghf.fh_nr JOIN flges ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.bez, flges.iata_cd ORDER BY airport_name, landing_count DESC
H02-SCH: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, flghf.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS count, flges.bez AS airline_name FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf.fh_nr JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd, flghf.bez, flges.bez ORDER BY count DESC, airline_name LIMIT 1
H02-BIZ: SELECT flgesbez, flgesnr, COUNT(*) as completed_arrivals FROM ( SELECT flgesbez, flgesnr, flug_id FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.abfl_fh WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flgesbez, flgesnr, flug_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ) AS completed_flights JOIN flges ON completed_flights.flgesnr = flges.flges_nr GROUP BY flgesbez, flgesnr ORDER BY completed_arrivals DESC
H02-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez AS airport_name, flges.bez AS airline_name, flges.gruend_jahr AS founding_year, flges.land AS country, flges.allianz AS alliance, flges.icao_cd AS icao_code, bes_mitgl.dienstalter_nr AS seniority_rank, bes_mitgl.pers_nr AS crew_member_id, bes_mitgl.eintr_dat AS hire_date, bes_mitgl.lizenz_ablauf AS license_expiry_date FROM flghf JOIN flges ON flges.hub_fh_nr = flghf.fh_nr JOIN bes_mitgl ON bes_mitgl.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr ORDER BY flghf.fh_nr, bes_mitgl.dienstalter_nr DESC
H03-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) AS month, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_invoiced, SUM(SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat)) AS running_total FROM rech_kopf WHERE strftime('%Y', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-SCH: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) AS month, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_brutto_usd, SUM(SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat)) AS running_total_brutto_usd FROM rech_kopf WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-VAG: SELECT SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_revenue FROM rech_kopf WHERE strftime('%Y', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) = '2023'
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) AS month, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights, SUM(wartg.arb_std) AS total_hours_maintenance, SUM(betankg.verbr_kg) AS total_fuel_consumed, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS total_co2_emitted FROM flug JOIN bes_eins ON flug.flug_id = bes_eins.flug_id JOIN wartg ON flug.flug_id = wartg.flug_id JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND bes_eins.eins_stat = 'completed' AND wartg.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H04-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) AS month, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(flug.flug_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist)) - COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS difference FROM flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) ORDER BY month
H04-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) AS month, SUM(sndg.ges_vol_m3) AS total_volume, SUM(sndg.ges_vol_m3) - LAG(SUM(sndg.ges_vol_m3)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist)) AS month_over_month_change FROM flug JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H04-VAG: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) AS month, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS flight_count, SUM(betankg.verbr_kg) AS total_fuel_consumed, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS total_co2_emitted FROM flug JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H05-CAS: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.kennz, AVG(julianday(flug.ank_ist) - julianday(flug.abfl_ist)) AS avg_ground_time FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.lfz_nr ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-SCH: SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG((julianday(flg.abfl_ist) - julianday(flg.ank_ist)) * 24) AS avg_time_diff FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flg.lfz_nr WHERE flg.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.kennz, AVG(julianday(flug.ank_ist) - julianday(flug.abfl_ist)) AS avg_turnaround FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.lfz_nr ORDER BY avg_turnaround ASC LIMIT 5
H05-VAG: SELECT param_wert FROM bm_param WHERE param_schl = 'as_of_timestamp'
H06-CAS: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, knd_stamm.kunnr, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_invoiced, (SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf)) * 100 AS share FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr WHERE knd_stamm.kunnr IN ( SELECT kunnr FROM vorf WHERE gemeldet_von = 'customer' GROUP BY kunnr HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ) GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1, knd_stamm.kunnr ORDER BY share DESC
H06-SCH: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / ( SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf ) AS avg_brutto_per_customer FROM zahlg JOIN rech_kopf ON zahlg.rech_id = rech_kopf.rech_id JOIN sndg ON rech_kopf.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr JOIN knd_stamm ON zahlg.kunnr = knd_stamm.kunnr WHERE zahlg.orig_waehr = 'USD' GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1 HAVING COUNT(rech_kopf.rech_id) * 100 / ( SELECT COUNT(rech_kopf.rech_id) FROM rech_kopf ) > 4
H06-BIZ: SELECT knd_stamm.kto_cd, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS revenue, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) * 100 / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf) AS share FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.kunnr GROUP BY knd_stamm.kto_cd HAVING SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) > (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf) * 0.04
H06-VAG: SELECT knd_stamm.kunnr, knd_stamm.name1, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(zahlg.betr_usd) AS total_paid, SUM(zahlg.betr_usd) / SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS revenue_share FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr JOIN zahlg ON rech_kopf.rech_id = zahlg.rech_id GROUP BY knd_stamm.kunnr, knd_stamm.name1 ORDER BY revenue_share DESC
H07-CAS: SELECT flghf.fh_nr, flghf.bez, SUM(sndg.fracht_gew_kg) AS total_cargo FROM flghf JOIN flug_ladg ON flghf.fh_nr = flug_ladg.urspr_fh JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr, flghf.bez ORDER BY total_cargo DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT flghf.bez, SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) AS tonnage, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) DESC) AS rank FROM flug_ladg JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr JOIN flghf ON flug.urspr_fh = flghf.fh_nr WHERE flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' GROUP BY flghf.bez ORDER BY tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT flghf.bez AS airport, SUM(CASE WHEN sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'DLV' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outbound_tonnage FROM flghf JOIN sdg_verfolg ON flghf.fh_nr = sdg_verfolg.fh_nr WHERE flghf.hub_kz = 1 AND flghf.nachtflugverb_kz = 0 GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez, flghf.fh_nr, flghf.hub_kz, flghf.nachtflugverb_kz, flghf.reg, flghf.anz_slb, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) AS export_count FROM flghf JOIN zoll_anm ON flghf.fh_nr = zoll_anm.sndg_nr WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'export' GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr ORDER BY export_count DESC LIMIT 10
H08-CAS: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights_more_than_half_full FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN betankg ON betankg.flug_id = flug.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND betankg.verbr_kg > lfz_typ.max_vol_m3 * 0.5 GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
H08-SCH: SELECT mdl, COUNT(*) FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND bes_eins.eins_stat = 'completed' AND wartg.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY mdl HAVING SUM(ges_vol_m3) > 0.5 * MAX(max_vol_m3)
H08-BIZ: SELECT lt.typ_nr, lt.mdl, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights FROM lfz_typ lt JOIN lfz l ON lt.typ_nr = l.typ_nr JOIN flug f ON l.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr JOIN flug_ladg fl ON f.flug_id = fl.flug_id WHERE f.stat = 'completed' AND fl.abschn_stat = 'flown' GROUP BY lt.typ_nr, lt.mdl HAVING SUM(fl.verbr_kg / (lt.max_vol_m3 * 1000)) / COUNT(*) > 0.5
H08-VAG: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' AND lfz.ges_flugstd BETWEEN lfz_typ.max_nutzl_kg / 2 AND lfz_typ.max_nutzl_kg
H09-CAS: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.kennz, lfz.msn, lfz.baujahr, lfz.stat FROM lfz JOIN flghf ON lfz.heimat_fh_nr = flghf.fh_nr WHERE flghf.hub_kz = 1 GROUP BY lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.kennz, lfz.msn, lfz.baujahr, lfz.stat HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT flghf.fh_nr) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1)
H09-SCH: SELECT DISTINCT flges.flges_nr AS kennz FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flugnr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug.ziel_fh IN ( SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1 )
H09-BIZ: SELECT DISTINCT lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.msn, lfz.baujahr FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN bes_eins ON flug.flug_id = bes_eins.flug_id JOIN wartg ON lfz.lfz_nr = wartg.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND bes_eins.eins_stat = 'completed' AND wartg.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.msn, lfz.baujahr HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT flug.abfl_fh) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1)
H09-VAG: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr, lfz.kennz, lfz.baujahr, lfz.flges_nr, lfz.stat, lfz.ausl_dat, lfz_typ.typ_nr, lfz_typ.anz_trw, lfz_typ.spannw_m, lfz_typ.max_reichw_km, lfz_typ.leergew_kg, lfz_typ.reise_geschw_kmh FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' AND lfz.lfz_nr IN (SELECT lfz_nr FROM flug GROUP BY lfz_nr HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT abfl_fh) > 1)
H10-CAS: SELECT zoll_anm.zoll_land, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) AS tax_count FROM zoll_anm JOIN sndg ON zoll_anm.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'import' AND (zoll_anm.zoll_betr_usd + zoll_anm.eust_usd) / sndg.dekl_wert_usd > 0.2 GROUP BY zoll_anm.zoll_land
H10-SCH: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) FROM zoll_anm WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND (zoll_betr_usd + eust_usd) > 0.2 * zollwert_usd GROUP BY zoll_land
H10-BIZ: SELECT zoll_anm.zollagent, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) AS entry_count FROM zoll_anm JOIN vorf ON zoll_anm.anm_id = vorf.ladg_id WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'import' AND zoll_anm.zollsatz_pct > 20 GROUP BY zoll_anm.zollagent
H10-VAG: SELECT zoll_anm.zoll_land, zoll_anm.zollwert_usd, zoll_anm.zollsatz_pct, zoll_anm.zoll_betr_usd, zoll_anm.eust_usd FROM zoll_anm JOIN lgr ON zoll_anm.lgr_nr = lgr.lgr_nr WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'import' AND lgr.sich_stufe = 'high'
